item.title: IRGC says 'oil smuggling' through Hormuz Strait has been completely halted
item.description:
IRGC says 'oil smuggling' through Hormuz Strait has been completely halted

An Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) navy official said that the "oil smuggling" through the southern route in the Strait of Hormuz has been fully halted.

"Following the destruction of enemy navigational aid systems on the southern rocks of the Strait of Hormuz, no offending vessel was able to enter the illegal passage last night, and the flow of oil smuggling through this passage was completely stopped," the unnamed official said according to local media.

item.title: Iranian official says no vital infrastructure damaged in US attack on Qeshm island
item.description:
Iranian official says no vital infrastructure damaged in US attack on Qeshm island

A provincial official indicated that no vital infrastructure or services were impacted by a US attack on Iran's Qeshm island overnight.

The Iranian official added that the targeted sites were away from residential and commercial areas.

item.title: Araghchi says Americans are 'sick and tired' of Israel embroiling US into 'Forever Wars'
item.description:
Araghchi says Americans are 'sick and tired' of Israel embroiling US into 'Forever Wars'

Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said that Americans are "sick and tired" of Israel dragging the US into several conflicts. 

Araghchi's comments came in response to a CBS News interview with Donald Trump, where the US president attributed the Republican Party’s midterm election defeat in part to voters' dislike of Israel.

"POTUS clearly recognizes that the vast majority of Americans are disgusted with Israel. Strikingly, he seems confused about why that's the case," the Iranian foreign minister said in a post on X. 

"Americans are evidently sick and tired of Israel bamboozling US administrations into Forever Wars. They had enough. So has our region."

item.title: Palestinian journalist released from Israeli detention condemns arrest as ‘political pressure’
item.description: Palestinian journalist Abdulkader Abu Shehadeh urged solidarity against political pressure targeting journalists and activists after Israeli authorities released him from detention on Sunday, Anadolu reports. Israeli police and the Shin Bet domestic security agency arrested Abu Shehadeh at his home in Jaffa on Nov. 4. Authorities detained Abu Shehadeh on suspicion of “communicating with a foreign agent” following an interview he conducted with Palestinian thinker Azmi Bishara regarding Israeli elections and the situation of Palestinians. Rejecting a police request for an eight-day extension, the Tel Aviv Magistrate’s Court ordered his detention until Nov. 8, leading to his release on Sunday without charges. Following his release, residents, activists, and civil society representatives welcomed Abu Shehadeh at the Jaffa Arab Affairs Association. […]

item.title: Iran says 2-day proposal stands, warns US against renewed attacks
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Sunday that Tehran’s two-day proposal to end the war remains on the table, urging the White House to meet Iran’s conditions and warning of a military response if Washington resumes attacks, Anadolu reports. “American voters have made their choice. Time for the White House to make its own,” Araghchi wrote on the US social media company X, referring to Tuesday’s US midterm elections. “Our 2-day proposal stands: meet the requirements, including end to war on all fronts, and you will see results,” he said. item.title: 2 Gazans killed, 12 others wounded in continued Israeli attacks
item.description: Two Palestinians, including a woman, were killed and 12 others, including a woman, were injured in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip since dawn Sunday, in the latest violations of a ceasefire in effect since October 2025, Anadolu reports. A medical source at Nasser Medical Complex said two Palestinians, including a woman, were killed and seven others sustained injuries of varying severity in an Israeli strike on a group of civilians in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza. A medical source told Anadolu Agency that four Palestinians were wounded, including one seriously, in an Israeli strike targeting a group of civilians in northern Gaza. item.title: US moves to deport 11 Iranians via Pakistan, rights group says
item.description: The US government moved to deport 11 Iranian nationals to Iran via Pakistan in an overnight operation that an advocacy organization claims violates a binding federal court order, according to an emergency court motion filed Sunday, Anadolu reports. “Plaintiff learned on the evening of Saturday, November 7, 2026… that ICE will remove eleven Iranian nationals—ten men and one woman—from the United States at approximately 4:00 a.m. on Sunday, November 8, 2026, on a flight to Islamabad, Pakistan, with a refueling stop in Georgia (the country) and onward transfer to the Islamic Republic of Iran on Tuesday, November 10,” the Iranian American Legal Defense Fund said in the emergency filing submitted to a US federal court.
